settings.visualStyle: Immersive first-person WWII historical reenactment, Stalingrad November 1942, ruined brick factories, shattered apartments, cold Volga wind, snow dust, smoke and rubble, Soviet Red Army soldier POV, non-graphic combat, no propaganda glamour, no modern objects, no game HUD.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 scenes x 8 seconds = 120 seconds. Fictional composite Soviet Red Army rifleman POV during the Stalingrad fighting as Operation Uranus begins and the German Sixth Army becomes encircled. One main action and one camera movement per scene. No spoken dialogue, no narration, no intelligible human speech. Audio uses breathing, nonverbal exertion, wind, rubble, equipment and distant battlefield effects only.
settings.customVisualStyle: Photorealistic first-person Stalingrad reenactment, cold blue-gray daylight, brick dust, smoke, practical winter uniforms, restrained handheld camera.

movie.storyTitle: WWII Soldier POV EP02 — Stalingrad: The Encirclement Begins
movie.storySummary: A fictional Soviet rifleman holds a shattered sector of Stalingrad in November 1942 while Operation Uranus begins outside the city. The episode remains close to the soldier's immediate experience and ends as the strategic situation shifts around the Axis army.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Put the viewer in the eyes of a fictional composite Soviet Red Army rifleman in Stalingrad during 19–23 November 1942. Show ruined urban positions, ammunition runs, short movements between buildings, cold weather, artillery and a visible shift in battlefield momentum. Tell everything visually. No spoken dialogue and no narrator. Human sound is limited to breathing and nonverbal exertion.

scenes.title: Cold Factory Dawn
scenes.description: POV wakes in a ruined factory position before dawn.
scenes.actionDescription: Gloved hands lift a Mosin-Nagant from a rubble-covered floor.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person Soviet soldier POV inside a ruined brick factory in Stalingrad, frosted breath, rifle in gloved hands, broken windows, dawn smoke.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow first-person rise from rubble to standing height. Audio: cold wind through broken windows, distant artillery, cloth and rifle movement, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Ammunition Count
scenes.description: The soldier checks a small supply of ammunition.
scenes.actionDescription: Hands count rifle clips on a wooden crate.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view of worn Soviet rifle clips on a crate among brick rubble, winter sleeves and gloves visible.
scenes.videoPrompt: Static POV with one counting action. Audio: metal clicks, distant shelling, wind, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Across the Courtyard
scenes.description: The squad crosses a rubble-filled courtyard to the next building.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV runs once across an open courtyard into a broken doorway.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person sprint across a shattered brick courtyard, snow patches, smoke, one squadmate reaching a doorway ahead.
scenes.videoPrompt: Single fast forward run ending inside doorway. Audio: boots on rubble, distant bursts, equipment bounce, heavy breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Basement Passage
scenes.description: The soldier moves through a dark basement connecting positions.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV follows one comrade through a narrow basement opening.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person Soviet soldier moving through a dark brick basement, candle stub, broken pipes, rubble, winter gear.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow forward handheld movement through one low basement corridor. Audio: boots, debris crunch, pipe creaks, distant artillery through walls, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Window Position
scenes.description: The POV reaches a firing position overlooking a ruined street.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier raises the rifle to one broken window and scans the street.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person rifle resting at shattered brick window overlooking an empty snow-dusted Stalingrad street, damaged buildings opposite.
scenes.videoPrompt: One slow horizontal scan through broken window. Audio: wind, distant guns, loose glass, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: The Barrage Changes
scenes.description: Heavy artillery is heard far beyond the city sector.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV lowers the rifle and turns toward the distant horizon sound.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person inside ruined apartment, rifle lowered, pale horizon visible through wall breach, distant smoke columns outside city.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow turn from street window toward distant horizon. Audio: deep rolling artillery from far away, cold wind, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Runner Arrives
scenes.description: A breathless runner arrives from another sector as the distant offensive intensifies.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV turns toward a snow-dusted runner entering the position and pointing toward the distant barrage.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view of a snow-dusted Soviet runner arriving inside ruined factory, pointing toward a distant direction while exhausted soldiers watch.
scenes.videoPrompt: Camera turns once toward the runner as he arrives and gestures silently. Audio: hurried footsteps, breathing, distant barrage, fabric movement. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Hold the Line
scenes.description: The unit prepares to maintain pressure inside the city.
scenes.actionDescription: Hands pull a winter glove tight and grip the rifle again.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person close view of winter glove tightening around rifle, brick barricade ahead, squadmates ready behind cover.
scenes.videoPrompt: Static close POV with one glove-tightening action. Audio: fabric, rifle metal, distant artillery, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Rubble Route
scenes.description: The soldier carries ammunition to another position through ruins.
scenes.actionDescription: POV carries one ammunition box across a broken interior passage.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person hands carrying a small ammunition box through shattered apartment interior, exposed beams, snow blowing through gaps.
scenes.videoPrompt: Steady forward movement while carrying box. Audio: box rattle, rubble footsteps, wind, distant combat, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Volga Wind
scenes.description: The POV reaches an opening with the Volga visible through smoke.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier pauses at one river-facing opening and looks toward the Volga.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view toward cold Volga river through ruined structures, low winter light, smoke, crates stacked under cover.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow push toward river-facing opening. Audio: strong wind, distant engines, water and loose debris, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Night in the Ruins
scenes.description: A brief time shift to night as the position remains active.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV warms hands over a small sheltered flame while artillery flashes beyond broken walls.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person gloved hands near a tiny protected flame in dark ruined factory, distant flashes outside, no graphic imagery.
scenes.videoPrompt: Static low POV; hands warm briefly as distant light flickers. Audio: wind, low artillery, fire crackle, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: The Ring Tightens
scenes.description: The next day the distant battlefield pressure is visibly increasing around the city.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV looks from a marked field map toward smoke on the horizon.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person Soviet position in daylight, rough field map on crate, gloved finger tracing an encircling route, ruined walls and winter light.
scenes.videoPrompt: One tilt from map toward the distant skyline. Audio: paper rustle, distant artillery, wind, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Linkup Sign
scenes.description: A newly marked map indicates Soviet spearheads have linked west of Stalingrad.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV watches a gloved hand draw the final connection on a field map while exhausted soldiers silently react.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view of a rough wartime map on a crate with a fresh line completing an encirclement, exhausted Soviet soldiers nearby, restrained expressions.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow tilt from map mark to nearby soldiers exchanging silent looks. Audio: pencil on paper, room tone, distant guns, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Still Fighting
scenes.description: The city battle continues despite the changing strategic situation.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV returns to the broken window position with rifle ready.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person rifle at shattered Stalingrad window again, smoke and ruined street beyond, cold daylight.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow forward move back to the window position. Audio: wind, distant combat, rifle movement, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Winter Horizon
scenes.description: The episode ends looking over the devastated city as the battle enters a new phase.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV lowers the rifle slightly and looks across the winter ruins.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person wide view across shattered Stalingrad under pale winter sky, smoke columns, Volga haze, no victory parade.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow upward tilt from rifle to broad ruined skyline. Audio: cold wind, distant artillery, breathing. End on unresolved battlefield atmosphere. No speech, no narration.

characters.name: POV Soldier
characters.role: Fictional composite Soviet Red Army rifleman
characters.description: Anonymous fictional composite soldier used as first-person viewer perspective; historically plausible 1942 Soviet winter uniform and rifle; face generally not shown.
characters.mainOutfit: Soviet winter field uniform, gloves, greatcoat elements, steel helmet where appropriate, Mosin-Nagant rifle

continuity.continuityRules: Keep gloves, sleeves, rifle and winter gear consistent. Avoid clear facial depiction.
